index.lede: Each course is reworked when the subject moves, and you keep access to the corrected version without paying again.
index.whyBody: I'd rather have two courses I keep up to date than a catalogue that makes up numbers. The opening module of each is free: you judge before you pay.
index.c1: Once paid, access is for life
index.c3: You pay with Wave, Orange Money or a card
index.c4: Certificate verifiable by its code, without an account
index.emptyBody: No course is online yet. I'd rather tell you than have you click into the void. Create your account now: it will be ready on opening day, and you will have nothing to fill in then.
index.emptyNote: No newsletter: when a course is announced, you can ask to be notified the day it opens — one email, and nothing else. In the meantime, the blog comes out every week.
index.whyBodyEmpty: I'd rather have two courses I keep up to date than a catalogue that makes up numbers. The opening module of each will be free: you'll judge before you pay.

sheet.truthTitle: What I can prove to you
sheet.truthBody: {{lessons}} lessons, {{modules}} modules, a certificate whose code checks out without an account. I show no rating and no student count: the platform just opened, I have nothing honest to say about it.
sheet.y1: You already sell something, even a little
sheet.y2: You want to apply it the same evening, not take notes
sheet.y3: You pay in CFA francs, no card abroad
sheet.n2: You want it done for you — see Local Presence
sheet.n3: You're a complete beginner: start with the blog, it's free
sheet.q1: What if it doesn't suit me?
sheet.a1: You have 14 days. Write to me, I refund — and if you tell me why, it helps me fix it.
sheet.q2: How long do I have access?
sheet.a2: For life. A reworked course stays accessible in its corrected version, without paying again.
sheet.a3: Write to me before paying. The amount charged is the one recomputed server-side, never the one your browser displays.
